summary: Pair 1 fits the Day 1 slot in unit_overall_plan exactly: auditory-only phoneme isolation and segmentation, no print. Sounder Sam anchors minds_on, action, and consolidation with the 'HOO knows the sounds? YOU do!' refrain. Materials are entirely everyday — drawn sound boxes, cut picture cards, bottle-cap counters — with the Sounder puppet explicitly OPTIONAL. The expanded_walkthrough names letter-name interference (Ehri 2005, Phase 2), which is the canonical Grade-1 phonics trap, and recovery moves are concrete teacher actions. Worksheet's three parts each practise a named success criterion from lesson_01, and Part 3 introduces 2 transfer items (FOX, JET) to verify generalisation. Cleared to scale to pair 2.
